title: Update Tauri to 2.11.5
summary: Update the locked Tauri runtime from 2.11.3 to the newly available compatible 2.11.5 patch through Cargo resolution.
reason: From apps/desktop/tauri/src-tauri with Cargo 1.95, cargo update -p tauri@2.11.3 --precise 2.11.5 --dry-run previewed only the Tauri patch. Running the same Cargo command without --dry-run reproducibly wrote the current lockfile, including nine compatible dependency-edge rebindings to the already locked windows-sys 0.60.2. Cargo.lock was not hand-edited.
behavior_before: The desktop shell lockfile selected Tauri 2.11.3.
behavior_after: The desktop shell lockfile selects Tauri 2.11.5; the Linux GTK path remains on gtk 0.18.2 and glib 0.18.5, so Dependabot alert 1 remains open.
tests_added: No tests added; existing locked Cargo, Tauri, and release/package gates validate the patch update.
manual_validation: PASS: cargo 1.95.0 reported the narrow tauri 2.11.3 -> 2.11.5 update with cargo update -p tauri@2.11.3 --precise 2.11.5 --dry-run.
PASS: cargo update -p tauri@2.11.3 --precise 2.11.5 reproducibly wrote the checked-in Cargo.lock delta; git diff -- Cargo.lock matched the PR lockfile and no lockfile content was hand-edited.
PASS: optimized Tauri release build with tauri 2.11.5.
PASS: root and Tauri npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities.

BLOCKED LOCALLY: copied-folder package launch was correctly rejected by the global single-instance guard because an unrelated Tauri shell from the user's primary checkout was already running; that process was not terminated or bypassed. GitHub Package Verify remains required.
rollback_plan: Use Cargo to resolve Tauri back to 2.11.3, inspect the lockfile delta, and rerun locked Cargo and Tauri validation.
notes: The --dry-run console preview did not disclose serialized dependency-edge rebindings; the non-dry-run Cargo command reproducibly wrote them. The affected packages are dirs-sys, errno, muda, rustix, rustls-platform-verifier, socket2, tempfile, tray-icon, and winapi-util. Cargo accepted windows-sys 0.60.2 for every edge, both 0.60.2 and 0.61.2 remain in the graph, and locked Cargo checks/tests plus the release build passed. The Linux graph remains gtk 0.18.2 -> glib 0.18.5, so issue #15 remains blocked.
